report.explanation: Order shows 500s and an errored checkout span, but no current evidence isolates a mechanism. Metrics show no db pool waiters or dependency timeouts, and payment, inventory, and gateway are healthy, so db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, and downstream-latency are unsupported. The deployment record alone cannot establish cause. No bounded candidate is substantiated; handoff with missing evidence.

Order memory time series over a longer window to assess memory-leak
Order configuration diff between 3.1.2 and 3.1.3 to assess bad-configuration
